analysis.verdict_rule: positive only when the paired relative-effect 95% confidence interval lower bound is at least 0.01

claim: Branch-normalized shared-gate ReZero improves final validation NLL over Pre-RMS by at least 1% under equal token and tuning budgets.

extension.reason: The initial paired effect was +1.92%, but its 95% confidence interval [-0.66%, +4.51%] crossed the preregistered 1% minimum.

falsification: The eight-seed paired 95% confidence interval lower bound remains below 1%.
Any condition receives a larger token or tuning budget.
The result depends on excluding a finite completed seed.
stopping_rule: Run all five additional seeds unless the declared failure budget is exceeded; do not stop for an interim positive or negative effect.
